The $HOME validation CANNOT be bypassed: SetAuthPath (controller.go) validates via config.ExpandSharedDir(authPath, home) before any persistence; ExpandSharedDir (internal/config/shared_dirs.go) rejects empty, ~otheruser, non-absolute, and any path whose filepath.Rel(home, abs) escapes home (".."/absolute) — so /etc/secret, ~/../etc, ~/.config/../../etc all error. postAppAuthPath (handler_apps.go) maps that error to HTTP 400. The override persists to apps.json (WriteApps) and List() returns the EFFECTIVE (override-or-catalog) authPath (v.AuthPath now computed from installedByID override, GET reflects it). Editing a not-installed app is refused (rec==nil -> error -> 400; TestSetAuthPath + acceptance both assert). When the old path was shared, the share MOVES within the SAME shared_dirs single source via c.shared.ApplySharedDirs (old dropped, new added). Route registered POST /api/apps/{id}/auth-path in server.go. Response shape is additive only: new endpoint + AppView.authPath now reflects override; no fields removed/renamed.
